1.consolidated_definition: Forma de pelear el gallo que no denota agresividad. Luce sin fuerza para tirar “a toa pata”. Caguas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Form of cockfighting that does not denote aggression. It appears without force to kick "a toa pata" (Caguas).
